lessons.title: 22.1 DNA as hereditary material
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain dna as hereditary material and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

Experiments by Griffith and later Avery, MacLeod, McCarty and Hershey–Chase established DNA as the hereditary material in many organisms.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: گریفتھ اور بعد میں ایوری، میکلوڈ، میکارٹی اور ہرشی–چیس کے تجربات نے DNA کو بہت سے جانداروں میں موروثی مادہ ثابت کیا۔
explanations.sd: گريفٿ ۽ پوءِ ايوري، ميڪلوڊ، ميڪارٽي ۽ هرشي–چيس جي تجربن DNA کي ڪيترن جاندارن ۾ موروثي مادو ثابت ڪيو.

lessons.title: 22.2 DNA replication
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain dna replication and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

DNA replication is semi-conservative: each daughter DNA molecule contains one parental strand and one newly synthesised strand.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: DNA کی نقل نیم محافظانہ ہوتی ہے؛ ہر نئے DNA سالمے میں ایک پرانی اور ایک نئی بننے والی زنجیر شامل ہوتی ہے۔
explanations.sd: DNA جي نقل نيم قدامت پسند هوندي آهي؛ هر نئين DNA ماليڪيول ۾ هڪ پراڻي ۽ هڪ نئين ٺهيل زنجير هوندي آهي.

lessons.title: 22.3 Genetic code
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain genetic code and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

The genetic code uses triplet codons in mRNA; it is nearly universal, degenerate and read in a defined direction.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: جینیاتی کوڈ mRNA میں تین حروف والے کوڈون استعمال کرتا ہے؛ یہ تقریباً عالمگیر، متعدد اور ایک مقرر سمت میں پڑھا جاتا ہے۔
explanations.sd: جينياتي ڪوڊ mRNA ۾ ٽن اکرن وارا ڪوڊون استعمال ڪري ٿو؛ اهو لڳ ڀڳ عالمگير، degenerate ۽ مقرر رخ ۾ پڙهيو وڃي ٿو.

lessons.title: 22.4 Gene expression
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain gene expression and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

Transcription makes RNA from DNA; translation uses ribosomes, mRNA and tRNA to assemble a polypeptide in the correct sequence.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: ٹرانسکرپشن میں DNA سے RNA بنتا ہے؛ ٹرانسلیشن میں رائبوسوم، mRNA اور tRNA درست ترتیب سے پولی پیپٹائڈ بناتے ہیں۔
explanations.sd: ٽرانسڪرپشن ۾ DNA مان RNA ٺهي ٿو؛ ٽرانسليشن ۾ رائبوسوم، mRNA ۽ tRNA صحيح ترتيب سان پولي پيپٽائڊ ٺاهين ٿا.

lessons.title: 22.5 Gene regulation and mutation
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain gene regulation and mutation and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

Regulatory proteins alter transcription; mutations change DNA sequence and may be neutral, harmful or occasionally beneficial in a given environment.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: ریگولیٹری پروٹین ٹرانسکرپشن بدلتے ہیں؛ میوٹیشن DNA کی ترتیب بدلتی ہے اور ماحول کے لحاظ سے غیر مؤثر، نقصان دہ یا کبھی فائدہ مند ہو سکتی ہے۔
explanations.sd: ريگيوليٽري پروٽين ٽرانسڪرپشن بدلائين ٿا؛ ميوٽيشن DNA جي ترتيب بدلائي ٿي ۽ ماحول موجب غير اثرائتي، نقصانڪار يا ڪڏهن فائديمند ٿي سگهي ٿي.

questions.question: Which statement best describes dna as hereditary material?

options.A: Experiments by Griffith and later Avery, MacLeod, McCarty and Hershey–Chase established DNA as the hereditary material in many organisms.
options.B: DNA replication is semi-conservative: each daughter DNA molecule contains one parental strand and one newly synthesised strand.
options.C: The genetic code uses triplet codons in mRNA; it is nearly universal, degenerate and read in a defined direction.
options.D: Transcription makes RNA from DNA; translation uses ribosomes, mRNA and tRNA to assemble a polypeptide in the correct sequence.
